laravel_adaptation.visibility: The control is hidden unless the authenticated frontend context carries tenant.view and users.view, or wildcard access.

security_boundary.authentication: The Laravel workspace and alias routes are authenticated.
security_boundary.tenant_context: The application-users alias is tenant-scoped and foreign tenant slugs fail closed.
security_boundary.permission: The destination requires tenant.view and users.view and the frontend hides the navigation without those permissions.
security_boundary.tenant_derived_url: The canonical source href is adapted to the active tenant URL rather than a global admin path.
security_boundary.mutation: The control performs navigation only; it issues no API request, persistence write, or WordPress mutation.

acceptance_tests: variants/laravel-aiwmweb/backend/tests/Feature/RolesApplicationUsersLinkTerminalityTest.php — binds the exact canonical row, proves source semantics and production wiring, verifies the canonical alias redirects to the real users workspace, and proves permission and foreign-tenant fail-closed behavior.

terminality.basis: The Roles & Permissions toolbar now exposes the canonical Application users navigation as a real tenant-scoped, permission-aware Laravel route transition.

scope_exclusions: No role create/update/assignment mutation is claimed
No sibling Roles & Permissions visible control is claimed
No generated parity ledger or reconciliation artifact is manually edited
